questions.text: In which one of the following page replacement policies, Belady's anomaly may occur?
questions.solution:
Belady's anomaly (more frames giving more faults) occurs with FIFO. Optimal, LRU and MRU are stack algorithms and do not show it.

Answer: FIFO

questions.text: For the real time operating system, which of the following is the most suitable scheduling scheme?
questions.solution:
Real-time tasks must meet deadlines, so an urgent task must be able to take the CPU immediately: pre-emptive (priority) scheduling.

Answer: Pre-emptive

questions.text: A CPU generates 32-bit virtual addresses. The page size is 4 KB. The processor has a translation look-aside buffer (TLB) which can hold a total of 128 page table entries and is 4-way set associative. The minimum size of the TLB tag is:
questions.solution:
Page number = 32 [latex]-[/latex] 12 = 20 bits.
TLB sets = 128 / 4 = 32 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 5 index bits.
Tag = 20 [latex]-[/latex] 5 = 15 bits

Answer: 15 bits

questions.text: Working Set (t,k) at an instant of time t is
questions.solution:
The working set W(t, k) is the set of pages referenced in the most recent window (the last k references, here described as the last t time units) before time t.

Answer: the k set of pages that have been referenced in the last t time units

questions.text:
Determine the number of page faults when references to pages occur in the following order:
1, 2, 4, 5, 2, 1, 2, 4
Assume that the main memory can accommodate 3 pages and the main memory already has the pages 1 and 2, with page one having brought earlier than page 2. (LRU page replacement algorithm is used)
questions.solution:
Frames start with [1, 2] (1 older), 3 frames, LRU:
- 1 hit, 2 hit, 4 fault [1, 2, 4]
- 5 fault: LRU is 1 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [2, 4, 5]
- 2 hit, 1 fault: LRU is 4 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [2, 5, 1]
- 2 hit, 4 fault: LRU is 5 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [2, 1, 4]

Faults = 4

Answer: 4
